text: Maakan ɓe an Nulaaɗo : "Hara no e kafidiiɓe mon ɓen ɓe rewoton gaanin Alla on mo no fewna e goonga?" Maakan ɓe : "Ko Alla tun woni fewnoowo e goonga. Hara ko on fewniroowo yimɓe ɓen e goonga, o nodda ɓe e mu'un ɓuri hanndude jok- keede, kaa ko reweteeɗi mon ɗe feewantah hoore mun ɗin si wanaa tuma goɗɗo fewni ɗi? Ko heɓi on sifa no ñaawirton meere nii, tuma aaƴotoɗon won- nde ko ɗi kafidiiɗi Alla? Alla toowirii toowannde mawnde e ngol konngol mon.
